question: ‘Sanghatil Manavi Vyavasthapan’ offering RSS insights, was authored by which politician published in May 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Nitin Gadkari**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The book titled **‘Sanghatil Manavi Vyavasthapan’** is authored by the senior **Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP)** leader and **Union Minister for Road Transport and Highways**, **Nitin Gadkari**.
 
• The publication, released in **May 2025**, provides unique insights into the organizational culture and human resource management strategies of the **Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh (RSS)**.
 
• The title **‘Sanghatil Manavi Vyavasthapan’** translates to **"Human Management in Organization,"** highlighting **Nitin Gadkari's** perspective on how the **RSS** builds and maintains its vast network of volunteers through interpersonal relationships and disciplined management.
 
• In this book, the author explores the **methodology of the Sangh** in nurturing leadership and fostering a sense of national service among its members. ***Hence, the correct answer is Nitin Gadkari.***
